Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
The Doctor wrote:
> Which set is that? I wanna look it up :)

Gehenna. Basically: Justicar or Inner Circle political action. Pick a
Camarilla vampire. If the referendum succeeds, go through your library
and put a piece of equipment on that vampire for half (round down) cost.
Additionally, that vampire may +1 stealth rush other vampires (like
Archon), but cannot commit diablerie.

> Again, which set is that Eye?

Promotional card, given away at tournaments.

http://monger.vekn.org/showcard.html?ID=1216

Basically, the minion's controller has to burn a pool each turn, or the
minion with the eye takes 5 unpreventable damage.

--Colin mcGuigan

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
The Doctor wrote:
> Oh btw, Talbot's CHainsaw says 'you'... Sounds like a problem to me :)
>
> "If bearer is ready during your untap phase, a ready minion you control
> takes 3 damage (damage not preventable)."
>
> Who's the you? Especially when you've moved it away to another
> Methuselahs vamp...
>
> This could be a problem even if someone 'Fast Hands' it from another.
> I guess noone ever uses Talbot's Chainsaw, his sounds like the kind of
> problem that would have been addressed way before now if it was a used
> card :)

By default, the "you" on a minion card refers to the controller of the
card. If the minion card is on a minion (eg, Talbot's on a vampire),
the default controller of the minion card is the controller of the minion.

So the "you" in this case would be the controller of the minion that has
Talbot's.

--Colin McGuigan

Oh, it's definitely used. One of the most frequent uses of it is to
use it in a Giovanni deck that has Ambrosius the Ferryman (from
Ancient Hearts/Final Nights) in play:

------------------
Ambrosius, The Ferryman (Wraith) [AH:R2, FN:PG]
Cardtype: Ally

Clan: Giovanni

Cost: 3 pool

Unique wraith with 2 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
Ambrosius is immune to damage that is not aggravated. He can move a
retainer from your ash heap to a ready vampire you control as an
action. Put 3 Pathos counters on the retainer. Remove a Pathos counter
from the retainer at the beginning of each of your minion phases. When
there are no Pathos counters remaining, remove the retainer from the
game.
----------------

So you use Talbot's Chainsaw, and always apply the 'damage to your own
minion' to Ambrosius, who is immune to it.

-John Flournoy
